title: Envi-Met automation Protocol: Standardized Environmental Modeling Automation and QGIS Plugin
description: A standardized protocol and QGIS 4 automation plugin for ENVI-met microclimate modeling developed within the LIFE A_GreeNET project. This software streamlines environmental simulation workflows, from automated multi-source geospatial data acquisition (DEM, building heights, canopy, land cover) to 3D model generation and scenario customization. Simulation results and output datasets are analyzed and visualized using the companion tool EnviReader.
